hero.title: CFBT Fire Behavior Training Facility
hero.description: In a safe, controlled live-fire environment, train firefighters to read fire, anticipate flashover, and apply the right hose tactics — that is the core value of CFBT.

jsonLd.productDescription: Live-fire training facility for fire behavior reading, flashover warning, and hose stream tactics.

overview.title: From suppression to understanding fire
overview.description: CFBT (Compartment Fire Behavior Training) teaches more than suppression — it trains firefighters to understand fire behavior: how smoke layers build, when flashover approaches, and how hose streams affect the fireground.
overview.lead: Solid-fuel fires reproduce real fire behavior, combined with temperature monitoring and ventilation control for training that is both realistic and safe.
overview.body: Designed to NFPA 1403/1402 and relevant domestic standards, with interlocking liners protecting structure and extending facility life.

features.title: Real fire behavior
features.desc: Solid fuels reproduce smoke layer development, rollover, and flashover precursors for fire behavior reading.

features.title: Flashover warning
features.desc: Observe flashover progression from a safe distance so trainees learn to recognize critical signs and act in time.

features.title: Hose stream & ventilation tactics
features.desc: Pulsed application and ventilation control train hose stream use and smoke layer management.

features.title: Controlled temperatures
features.desc: Temperature monitoring at ceiling and working level balances realism with crew safety.

features.title: Interlocking insulation liner
features.desc: Calcium silicate interlocking liners withstand high heat, protect structure, and allow single-tile replacement.

features.title: Repeatable training
features.desc: Controlled fuel and conditions support high-frequency, repeatable standardized training.

programs: Smoke layer observation and fire behavior reading
Ventilation control and smoke layer management
Attack route selection and safe withdrawal
